title: Punctured local-domain bound from a coefficient field and dimension induction
statement:
Let F be a separably closed field, R a local F-domain whose coefficient reduction to its residue field is bijective, h a nonzero element of the maximal ideal, and trdeg_F Frac R=e with 0<e<=n+2. Given the all-fields affine bounds in dimensions less than n+2, Spec R[1/h] has torsion cohomological dimension at most e. Use torsion cohomological dimension as in [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd], the strict localization as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] when it occurs, and Krull dimension as in [def-kun-dimension]. The following verbatim Lean statement specifies all universes, hypotheses, scalar structures, sheaves and degrees:

theorem hasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE_punctured_of_coefficientField
    (n : ℕ)
    (hIH : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] (m c : ℕ), m < n + 2 →
      (Spec (.of L)).HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE c →
      ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of L))
        [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a],
        topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (m : WithBot ℕ∞) →
          X.HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE (m + c))
    (F R : Type u) [Field F] [IsSepClosed F] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra F R]
    (_hres : Function.Bijective
      ((IsLocalRing.residue R).comp (algebraMap F R)))
    (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e) (hed : e ≤ n + 2)
    (htr : letI : Algebra F (FractionRing R) :=
      ((algebraMap R (FractionRing R)).comp (algebraMap F R)).toAlgebra
      Algebra.trdeg F (FractionRing R) = (e : Cardinal.{u}))
    (h : R) (hh : h ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (hh0 : h ≠ 0) :
    (Spec (.of (Localization.Away h))).HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE e

proof.text: For every nonzero polynomial P, factor its lowest power of T and evaluate at h. The remaining factor has nonzero residue and is a unit. Thus every nonzero P(h) is a unit after h is inverted, giving an explicit RatFunc F-algebra structure on R[1/h]. Both rings embed compatibly in Frac R.

The transcendence-degree tower formula bounds trdeg over RatFunc F by e-1. Every finitely generated RatFunc F-subalgebra is a domain of dimension at most e-1 by Noether normalization and dimension/transcendence degree equality.

The existing proved source declaration hasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE_one_ratFunc supplies the rational-function field bound one directly, without the open derived-cohomology wrapper. This bound and hIH with m=e-1 and c=1 give a uniform bound e for all these affine spectra. Their affine inverse limit is Spec R[1/h]. Affine-limit cohomology transfers the bound to that limit, including e=1.
